explication: dsh-purge is a local DeepSeek Harness red-team plugin. The user opens its dock, chooses Clean or Drill, and applies changes to an official Web or desktop installation; changes can later be restored or uninstalled. Clean covers prompt/rule configuration and host patching, while Drill provides authorized asset, skill, and environment assessment with reports. The graph includes the documented update and startup reapply capabilities. Relationships are limited to README statements and shown source references; unsampled implementation details are not assumed.
